description: Illustrative LCD-style medical necessity policies. Phase 4 deterministically checks whether any CONFIRMED diagnosis coded for the encounter matches a procedure's covered_indications list. This is not real payer LCD/NCD text -- it exists to demonstrate the necessity-gate pattern; production use would pull the payer's actual LCD/NCD via its policy ID.

policies.necessity_note: Most payers do not cover lumbar MRI for uncomplicated low back pain under 6 weeks duration without red-flag symptoms or a documented trial of conservative therapy.
